# name-length

Limit Feature and Scenario name length, or Feature, Rule, Scenario, and Step lengths separately.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| naming | no | no | `{"max":80}` |

Limits Feature and Scenario names. Per-node limits `{ Feature, Rule, Scenario, Step }` also check Rule names and step text; each missing key defaults to 70.

## Configuration

```json
{ "rules": { "name-length": ["error", {"max":80}] } }
```

## Triggered by

```text
Scenario: A name longer than the configured maximum
```
